name: @pipeworx/mcp-foursquare

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search Foursquare places (keyless — Pipeworx supplies the key). Combine `query` (e.g., "coffee", "hardware store") with a location anchor — either `near` ("Brooklyn, NY", "San Francisco, CA") or `latitude`+`longitude`. sort:"RATING" orders results by Foursquare rating (best first); the rating NUMBER itself is a Foursquare Premium field and is returned only where enabled — check `rating_included` / `rating_reason` in the response, and read `rating_note` before telling a caller a place is unrated. Returns name, fsq_place_id, categories, address, distance, lat/lon, tel, website.

categories.description: OPTIONAL. Comma-separated numeric fsq_category_id values ONLY (e.g. from a prior search_places result). Do NOT invent IDs or pass category names — use the `query` text for that (e.g. query:"coffee"). Unknown IDs are ignored.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Full place details by fsq_place_id. Returns name, categories, address, lat/lon, social media, website, tel. hours/rating/price/popularity are Foursquare Premium fields — present only where enabled (see `rating_included` / `rating_note` in the response).

tools.name: nearby_places
tools.description: Return POIs sorted by distance from a lat/lon without a text query. Requires latitude+longitude; optional radius_m (default 500m) and numeric fsq_category_ids filter. Returns name, categories, address, distance, tel, website. rating/hours/popularity are Foursquare Premium fields — present only where enabled (see `rating_included` / `rating_note`).

categories.description: OPTIONAL numeric fsq_category_id values only (from a prior result). Do NOT invent IDs; unknown IDs are ignored.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-foursquare forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the foursquare pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
